thread:
marie: quick q — noticed the console heatmap doesn't light up for preview cohorts during config-driven surge tests. we ran a canary that bumped route X to 15% but dashboard stayed flat. any ideas?

jason: did you run the preflight sampling? default is 1% so tiny cohorts get lost.

marie: i thought preview cohorts were tagged, they should surface even at low sampling.

anil: console only shows aggregated routes from the telemetry rollup, we drop cohort tags unless sampling>0.5. that's on us.

kat: UX question — do we want to show an explicit "preview" lane in the heatmap or overlay cohorts? overlay gets noisy.

rachel: overlay + mute low-signal cohorts by default sounds fine. maybe a toggle: "show previews".

dmitri: fwiw the telemetry backend can emit a cohort_presence flag during preflight. small change. example payload: ```json
{"route":"route-x","cohort":"preview-2026-03-21","sampling":0.15,"cohort_presence":true}
```

jason: perfect. if backend emits cohort_presence we can make the console highlight even for sampling<1%. will need a short API change: /v1/rollup -> include cohort_presence true/false.

ops-bot: [alert] test-cluster-a: route-x surge test at 15% for 2026-03-21T14:32:00Z (auto-pause disabled) :warning:

marie: ops-bot — thanks. question: what's the recommended rollout policy for these surge-driven config changes? we want to catch SLO regressions but still test throughput.

anil: i'd do staged canary: 1% -> 5% -> 15% with 10m observation windows and latency + error rate gates. add a telemetry probe for request tail-latency.

kat: console should show gate state in the rollout timeline (green/yellow/red) with click-to-expand for underlying metrics. also show quota burn rate so PMs can understand cost.

jason: implementing gate state needs two bits: probe name + evaluation result. we'll add `probe_results` in the rollout API. example: ```json
{"probe":"tail_p95","status":"ok","value":120} // ms
```

marie: also need to know if routing fallback kicked in (i.e., requests rerouted to cheaper model). that's currently invisible in rollouts.

dmitri: routing fallback emits a routing_event stream but we don't join it to config-rollout traces. we can add a trace_id header so both ends correlate. tiny infra work.

rachel: callout: make sure ephemeral preview configs have TTL + visible expiry in console. people push previews then forget about them.

anil: agree. add expiry and auto-cleanup + an audit note. TTL default 24h for preview configs.

marie: action items: i'll open a short RFC for cohort_presence + probe_results + trace_id correlation. kat can prototype the "show previews" toggle in the heatmap. jason will add probe_results to /v1/rollup contract. dmitri will emit cohort_presence and trace_id joins.

kat: ack — i'll do a mock and drop screenshots in #design later today.

jason: i'll run a canary tomorrow with higher sampling to validate flow.

ops-bot: [info] created ticket INF-4567: "cohort presence + rollout telemetry enhancements" (assignee: marie) :white_check_mark:

marie: thanks team. one last tiny ask — can the console annotate the rollout timeline with the sampling rate used per step? that'll help debugging.

dmitri: yes, add `sampling` to rollout step metadata. small schema bump.

marie: awesome — closing for now, will link RFC in this thread once it's up. :thumbsup:
